system.longDesc: You can use 2 Move Points to position yourself between a foe and something or someone else. This position is either adjacent to the person or thing you wish to protect or in a straight line between it/them and your foe. Until the beginning of your next turn, that foe must succeed at a minor action Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Might) test vs. your Defense to move closer to whomever or whatever you wish to protect.
